title: Present-wait semaphore indexed by the frame number instead of the acquired swapchain image
expected_finding: the submit signals and vkQueuePresentKHR waits on m_frames[m_frame_number].present_ready_semaphore; the frame's render_fence does not cover the present's wait, so a later frame using the same slot may re-signal the semaphore before the earlier present has consumed it, and the frame number is not tied to the acquired image index (VUID-vkQueueSubmit-pSignalSemaphores-00067)
